messages:
Zara Nadeem: Heads-up — BrightRoad (enterprise) shows a steep decline in feature adoption after onboarding week. Renewal in 19 days. I want to propose a "usage rehab" play that combines a quick config safety net + lightweight enablement. Thoughts?

Caleb Ortiz: Can we pull the exact funnel? Which step is the cliff?

Priya Menon: Onboarding funnel: 68% finish setup, but active usage by day 10 is 14%. Drop mostly occurs at 'multi-file ingest -> vectorize' and subsequent QA checks.

Omar Bennett: Infra logs show a lot of client retries and duplicated jobs for >8MB uploads. Not seeing 5xx, but latency SLOs are tripping and token costs spike.

Zara Nadeem: Proposed compact "usage rehab" steps: 1) 15-min triage with PM + eng 2) apply a reversible safety config (limit concurrency, enable prefix caching) 3) 25-min enablement + checklist for best import patterns 4) 72-hr watch + metric snapshot 5) escalation to renewals if no improvement. Owner: @Priya.

Caleb Ortiz: We should prepare a bridge option if they ask for immediate cost reduction: "throttle-preserve" plan — preserves API keys, model pins, and audit logs but caps throughput. Time-limited (30 days) and reversible.

Priya Menon: I'll draft the invite + a tiny 1-page summary for the renewals rep. Invite copy: "Hi {{name}}, we noticed activity dip. Can we do a 15-min triage tomorrow to try one quick config change and demo that usually fixes this?"

Omar Bennett: Ops mitigation ready: org-scoped safety snippet — ```json
{"org_id":"brightroad","max_concurrency":2,"enable_prefix_cache":true,"max_upload_mb":6,"fallback_route":"dedicated-small"}
``` I'll stage it.

Zara Nadeem: Good. Add explicit rollback instructions: document the single API call to revert the safety config and the steps to remove the bridge plan. Keep everything auditable for renewals.

Caleb Ortiz: I'll create the renewal bullet note: cause, actions taken, rollback path, short success criteria (import success >90%, WAU +25% in 7 days), and next steps.

cs-helper-bot: Created ticket CS-10012 for BrightRoad usage rehab. Priority: Medium. Owner: Omar Bennett.

Priya Menon: After the triage we'll capture: pre/post screenshots (import success), whether they had prefix caching enabled, and direct customer feedback on docs. Tag play: usage-rehab-compact.

Omar Bennett: Staged safety config smoke tests: 100 synthetic imports at new caps, retries reduced ~85%. Ready to promote after triage.

Zara Nadeem: Timeline: triage tomorrow, safety config promoted within 4 hours post-call if agreed, 72-hr monitoring snapshot, renewal note 7 days before renewal.

Caleb Ortiz: If they still want to cut spend we offer the throttle-preserve plan for 30 days with a re-eval at 14 days. Keeps them from fully downgrading.

Priya Menon: I'll own meeting logistics and the 1-pager for renewals. Will paste meeting notes + post-promotion metrics here.

Omar Bennett: Will post prod logs and token delta after promotion.

Zara Nadeem: Thanks team. If we see recovery we'll fold this into a templated play + add checklist and config snippets to the CS playbook library. :rocket:
